visualSummaries.text: Deep blue editorial field. Letterspaced FURNITURE REFERENCE eyebrow with the logo lockup at the top, then a two tone headline and a line of setup. Below it two rounded photo cards stacked vertically, each a wide horizontal band holding one sofa at almost the same scale, which is the whole point of the frame. The upper card is a Stagify render of a luxury living room cropped to the seating: a deep aubergine button tufted velvet sofa with two ivory cushions, flanked by walnut side tables and tall brass and glass lamps, two gilt picture frames above, a marble and walnut coffee table with cut glass decanters across the front. The lower card is the owner's own photograph of that same aubergine tufted sofa with two white cushions, shot straight on against white panelled doors with antiqued mirror glass. Small blue pills read STAGED and YOUR SOFA. Aubergine, walnut, ivory and brass against the blue chrome.

Two stacked panels on the deep blue field. The top panel is muted red and carries the belief that free means a watermarked preview, with a short concession under it. The bottom panel is brand blue and states that free means the finished file, with a note naming what is included and what is not. Sitting inside the right edge of the blue panel, faded in from the left, is a warm crop of a midcentury kitchen render: a cream retro range with chrome trim and six knobs, a cream fridge, patterned cream and gold tile, amber oak cabinets and a sliver of fruit bowl on the counter.

A type first card on the deep blue field. A very large brand blue numeral 97 with a smaller percent sign, a white claim line under it, a muted support sentence and a small source line naming the NAR report. Across the lower third a wide photo band showing a red brick house facade in raking golden hour light, arched upper windows, a gabled entry canopy and a porch lamp, with a strip of clear blue sky at the left. A small pill on the band reads GOLDEN HOUR.

A five slide deep blue swipe deck. Slide one is a tight crop of a completely empty room, white walls, pale oak floor, a window at the left and a door at the right, under a dark scrim with the question what is this room for and a swipe chevron. Slides two, three and four each sit on the deep blue field with a short line, a note and one rounded photo card of the same room staged as an office, then a guest room, then a reading room, each carrying a use pill. The window, radiator, sill, cornice, doorway and floorboards are identical in all three. Slide five is the deep blue closing field with the ask and a single white pill. Warm chalk white and pale oak against the blue chrome.

Full bleed dining room split by a steep bright blue diagonal wipe running from the lower left to the upper right. Left of the line the room is cluttered with boxes, bottles and papers across the table and sideboard. Right of the line the same room is cleared and staged with a set table and upholstered chairs. Dark BEFORE pill top left, white logo pill top right, blue AFTER pill at the lower right above the button. Two line headline bottom left over a dark scrim. Warm oak and olive against the blue chrome.

Full bleed photo of a luxury living room with a cream sectional, marble coffee table, gold and black triptych and a sputnik chandelier. A soft vertical light seam near the right edge reveals the empty version of the same room behind a blue tinted dotted scrim, so the reveal runs vertically instead of diagonally. Large white uppercase two line headline across the top. Three small white pills along the bottom left reading STYLE LUXURY, a timer, and 1 CLICK, with a disclosure pill bottom right. A pale blue footer band carries a navy line, a grey line and the wordmark.

Top to bottom split rather than left to right. White headline and pale blue subhead sit over a blue gradient wash on the upper photo of an empty white brick room. A jagged zigzag bright blue band cuts across the middle carrying the letterspaced words 8 SECONDS. Below it the same room staged coastal with a teal painted brick wall, white slipcovered sofa, rattan armchairs and framed seascapes. Small white BEFORE and AFTER pills on the left edge of each half. A white footer card with a navy line of copy and a blue Stagify.ai pill, then a small centred tagline.

A comic strip. Navy header bar with a white uppercase title and a small letterspaced subtitle, plus a blue starburst badge reading ONE CLICK top right. Three stacked panels with thick navy borders on a pale blue field. Panel one is an empty room photo with a flat illustrated stick figure and a white speech bubble. Panel two is a dotted field with the figure holding a phone, a drawn swoosh arrow, and a navy caption block. Panel three is a fully staged midcentury bedroom with a blue STAGED starburst and a disclosure pill. A solid blue footer bar carries the call to action and a middot separated feature line.

A solid brand blue header bar across the top with a white uppercase headline and the Stagify wordmark. The frame is then split into two full width horizontal panels. The top panel is a top down floor plan render on a faint blue grid with a blue FLOOR PLAN pill. The bottom panel is the same space as a photoreal three quarter interior render with a blue AI RENDER pill, showing a fireplace, seating and a canopy bed. A white rounded caption pill sits across the bottom of the lower panel. Cool greys, pale oak and soft blue throughout.

Square format. Pale periwinkle field with a fine dot texture and a thin border frame. Huge uppercase outlined headline top left in navy then bright blue, with a football emoji at the right. One large photo card split left to right by a hand drawn wavy navy divider, cluttered wood panelled basement on the left and a finished sports den with a bar, swivel chairs, framed jerseys and a neon sign on the right. Dark BEFORE and blue AFTER pills at the top corners. A white speech bubble callout over the left photo. White footer card with a line of copy and a blue Free at Stagify.ai button.

Bright saturated yellow field, not the usual brand blue. Small grey letterspaced eyebrow and a large deep blue headline top left, circular logo mark top right. One wide hero card showing a living room redrawn entirely in flat cartoon style with an orange couch, yellow fireplace and primary colour armchairs, carrying a yellow LIVING ROOM pill and a white caption. Below it three smaller cards labelled KITCHEN, BEDROOM and DINING, each a photo blended with the same cartoon treatment. Small grey footer line. Playful, high contrast, nothing else in the account looks like it.

Deep brand blue field. Logo lockup top left, letterspaced eyebrow top right. Two line headline, white clause then pale blue clause, muted subhead. A wide before and after comparison card of a covered brick patio with BEFORE and AFTER pills at the outer corners and a circular drag handle on the seam, plus a white caption pill below the seam. Under it a second full bleed photo card of a coastal living room with a COASTAL style pill and a caption. Footer with Free AI staging left, Virtually staged and a white Try free pill right. Warm brick, wood and green foliage against the blue.

Deep brand blue field. Logo lockup top left, letterspaced AI VIRTUAL STAGING eyebrow top right. Two line headline, white clause then pale blue clause, muted subhead. One wide hero photo of an empty white living room with a fireplace carrying a translucent Empty room pill. Below it five staged variants of the same room in a three then two grid, each rounded, each with a blue style pill and a white buyer persona caption. Footer with Free AI staging left and a white Try free pill right.

Full bleed photo of a bright modern living room split corner to corner by a bright blue diagonal line with a soft glow. Empty above the line, staged below. Dark BEFORE pill top left, white logo pill top right, blue AFTER pill on the right at mid height. Two line headline bottom left over a dark scrim, white clause then bright blue clause. Blue Try free pill bottom right. Grey, white and pale wood tones with almost no colour beyond the blue chrome.
